in_sanskrit.name: Hiresh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sun God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hiresh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Hiresh is a Sanskrit name derived from Hiranyagarbha, the Hindu god of creation. It represents the supreme being and the source of all life. Hiresh is a tribute to the divine power that brought forth the universe.
